If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 2 ([email:67a09047] onboarding), welcome call held ([calendar:b4df6b98]), so some engagement. But no reply to either outreach ([email:9f6f5675]), no invite sent, no tickets, and key milestone still unreached at day 6 with 8 days left — momentum looks thin.

draft.subject: Next step after your Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week — good to see your first project already up in Wrenfield.

The usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if there are a few of them.

If it's easier, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through what you want Quartz Ventures working on in there first.

Best,
Nadia
